issues.title: Flat on the bed
issues.message: Nothing on the bottom of this part sits flat on the print bed — it is rounded or tilted. It will need supports and may wobble or detach while printing.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so its largest flat face is on the bottom, or add a flat base before exporting.

issues.title: Minimum thickness 0.5 mm
issues.message: Thinnest wall is 0.08 mm (limit 0.50 mm), across about 52.2 mm² of the part. Walls this thin may print with gaps or not at all.
issues.suggestion: Thicken thin walls, fins and plates to at least 0.5 mm — 1.2 mm or more for strength.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 194% of the part's volume (202.2 cm³ of support for 104.4 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: Requires Support

issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.
